explanation.explanation: Panel a is a schematic illustration plus example micrographs demonstrating image cropping/rotation/resizing; it has no quantitative plot axes.
Panel b shows schematic outlines and micrographs illustrating spacing between separate images; there are no quantitative plot axes to label.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating an inset/zoom relationship; there are no quantitative plot axes.
Panel d is a conceptual Min/Max brightness-contrast slider illustrated above three example micrographs; it is not a quantitative plot with a data axis requiring units.
Panel e shows schematic circles and labeled micrographs illustrating channel annotation visibility; there are no quantitative plot axes.
Panel f shows a schematic and grayscale/merged micrographs illustrating channel separation; there are no quantitative plot axes.

Panel g presents two intensity/pseudocolor calibration scale bars with numeric tick values (165 to 2,832, labeled Min/Max) attached to the micrographs. These are effectively quantitative color axes for pixel intensity, but neither the figure nor the caption states what units these numbers are in (e.g., arbitrary units, photon counts, grey levels), so the axis lacks a defined unit.
